requestBar.name: Accessible label of the field for the name of a request.
requestBar.untitled: Name shown for a request that has no name yet.
requestBar.method: Accessible label of the HTTP method picker.
requestBar.url: Accessible label of the address input.
requestBar.urlPlaceholders.full: Placeholder of the address input when there is room. The three variants go from long to short for narrower screens.
requestBar.urlPlaceholders.medium: Shorter placeholder of the address input.
requestBar.urlPlaceholders.short: Shortest placeholder of the address input. Keep URL.
requestBar.methodPlaceholders.grpc.full: Placeholder of the address input for gRPC requests; localhost:50051 is an example address.
requestBar.methodPlaceholders.mcp.full: Placeholder of the address input for MCP requests.
requestBar.connect: Button that opens a WebSocket or similar live connection.
requestBar.disconnect: Button that closes a live connection.
requestBar.cancel: Button that cancels a request in flight.
requestBar.save: Button that saves the request to the collection.
requestBar.code: Button that opens generated code for the request, as in code snippet.
requestBar.codeHint: Tooltip and title for the button that opens code generation.
requestBar.codeLanguage: Label of the programming language picker of the code snippet window. Not a human language.
curlFiles.title: Title of a confirmation after pasting a curl command that reads local files.
curlFiles.withThem: Button: paste the command including its file reads.
curlFiles.withoutThem: Button: paste the command without its file reads.
